history.summary: A local Lakshmi-Narayana shrine on Hospital Road, Kumarghat; no published history found. Identity is provisional: the CSV name is generic and no dedicated web record exists. Coordinates are corroborated by a 'Laxminarayan temple' POI on Kumarghat Hospital Rd (24.162794, 92.039226); the geocoder itself only resolved street level (Kumarghat Chowk, 24.16304, 92.03734), so use town-level precision.

name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple
town_description: Kumarghat is a town and subdivision headquarters in Unakoti district, northern Tripura, on the Lumding–Sabroom railway line and NH-8. It is the railhead for the famous Unakoti rock-cut archaeological site, about 29 km away, and a market town for the surrounding area.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~200 km by road)
travel.road: Hospital Road off NH-8 through Kumarghat

visitor_information.opening_hours: Unpublished (verify); local temples generally open dawn to dusk
